name: Porto de Lisboa, Tejo Live
owner: APL, Administração do Porto de Lisboa
how: One GET of the operator's camera page an hour (sources/cams/collect.mjs): up, down or page up without a player. The page's bytes are dropped; no frame, snapshot or stream is ever fetched. Shown by link to the operator's page.

why.basis: A public port authority's own public camera page; no linking or embedding terms found (only a '© APL' footer and a note that nothing is recorded). We link to the page and keep status only.

notes: Two cameras (Cacilhas, VTS at Algés), sited in Almada and Oeiras, showing Lisbon; listed under lisboa.
